title: Blowing up minimal intersections of a weakly normal crossings family
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian regular scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme], [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $B$ be a strict normal crossings divisor [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $(Y_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite family of nowhere dense closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose that every scheme-theoretic intersection indexed by a nonempty subset $J\subseteq I$ $Y_J=\bigcap_{j\in J}Y_j$ is regular and has normal crossings with $B$: etale locally its ideal is generated by a subset of a regular system of parameters in which $B$ is the product of distinct parameters. Let $C$ be the union of the nonempty inclusion-minimal members among these intersections. Then the members of this union are pairwise disjoint, $C$ is regular and has normal crossings with $B$, and for $p:X'=\operatorname{Bl}_C X\to X$ [def-nagata-global-blowup] the scheme $X'$ is regular, the exceptional divisor is regular, and $B'=(p^{-1}(B\cup C))_{\rm red}$ is strict normal crossings with its divisorial fs log structure log regular [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. If $Y_i'$ denotes strict transform [def-nagata-strict-transform], then $\bigcap_{j\in J}Y_j'$ is the strict transform of $Y_J$; all these intersections are regular and have normal crossings with $B'$. The total transform ideal of $Y_J$ is the product of its strict-transform ideal and the Cartier ideal of the union of exceptional components above $Y_J$.

Iterating this operation on the strict transforms terminates after at most $|I|$ steps if the intersection family is closed under intersection and has at most $|I|$ distinct members. In general the number of steps is the maximal length of a strict chain of nonempty intersections. Every original $Y_J$ then has empty strict transform and invertible total-transform ideal. The construction commutes with isomorphisms preserving the family, including permutations of $I$. The empty family produces the tower of length zero.
